title: Regular Curves, Singular Graphs: Cantor Parts and the Relaxed Willmore Energy
summary: One might expect that finite relaxed elastic energy rules out diffuse singularities in the derivative, leaving only absolutely continuous and jump parts. This is suggested by the role of $SBV$ in free-discontinuity problems and by interpreting jumps as vertical segments of limiting graphs. We show that it fails for the relaxed one-dimensional Willmore energy. We construct a continuous function $u\in BV((0,1))$ with $D^c u\neq0$ and $\overline{\mathcal{W}}(u) 1$.
